body: eps_headlines_to_records() joins var/eps/articles.ndjson against oracle.ndjson by source_identity, one record per article never chunked, verdict-gated (only confirmed cases FABLE-eligible per Lobian rule 1). write_snapshot() produces immutable content-addressed pairs under var/snapshots/ -- the manifest contract Go fabledata inherits. Eval tombstoning wired (no-op until S145-02 freezes a suite). New --fable-eps preset. 12 new tests, 40 total, all green. Verified live against the real (currently unreconciled) EPS oracle store. commit gpt2-alpine-c 458756c.
title: S146-01..04: EPS snapshot pipeline for FABLE E0 (Track B)
